hero.title: Talk to it the way a customer would
hero.lede: Press call inside the app and speak. It hears you, reads the manual and answers aloud. The models run on your PC.

callScreen.title: The call screen
lede: It shows live captions and what the agent is doing at each moment. The words above come from a chat on the test day; the same flows answer chats and calls.

image.alt: The call screen in the app with live captions.

voiceTools.title: Voice tools that come with it

steps.title: Text to speech
steps.text: Type a line and get a voice. Yours, from ten seconds of speech.

steps.title: Speech to text
steps.text: Turn recordings into text you can search and click through.

steps.title: A private chat
steps.text: An assistant that can read your documents, for your own questions.

hardCalls.title: People still take the hard calls
hardCalls.lede: If a caller needs a person, the agent says so and passes on what it has already found.

image.alt: A support agent with a headset smiling at a computer.

items.question: Can it answer my phone number?
items.answer: Not yet. You can test calls inside the app today. Connecting a real phone line is the next piece of work.

items.question: Which voices can I use?
items.answer: Kokoro on every machine, and LFM3-Audio or Qwen3-TTS with a graphics card. You download all of them from Settings.
